title: Venezuelan Fried Rice with Jazzy Twist
description: A Chinese-inspired dish with a unique twist of Venezuelan flavors, featuring a flavorful fried rice dish with the added zing of jazzy seasoning.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and minced garlic (if using) and stir-fry until the onion is translucent.
Add cooked rice, Venezuelan seasoning, and Jazzy seasoning. Stir-fry for about 2-3 minutes.
Add frozen peas and grated carrots (if using). Stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Use a spatula to break up any clumps and stir-fry for another minute.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and garnish with chopped scallions or cilantro (if desired).
